privacy.html.title: Privacy Policy | Hoppo
privacy.html.description: How Hoppo handles your data: explicit consent for health data, photos that stay on your phone, EU storage, advertising choices and your GDPR rights.

units.2: Hoppo is operated by Matej Mesko, Slovenia, who is the data controller under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This policy covers the Hoppo app for iPhone and Android and the website hoppoapp.com.
units.4: We store what the app needs to work: your account, your children's profiles, pregnancy details, logs and calendar.
units.5: Some of this is health data. We only store it with your explicit consent, which you give when you create your account.
units.6: Photos stay on your phone. They are never uploaded.
units.7: Your data is stored in the European Union. We never sell it.
units.8: You can delete everything in the app at any time.
units.10: Account. Your email address, a password, your country and language, and your app settings. If you sign in with Google or Apple, we receive your email address from them. Passwords are handled and encrypted by our authentication provider, Supabase. We never see or store readable passwords.
units.11: Child and pregnancy profiles. A name or nickname, a date of birth or due date, and, if you choose, your child's sex (used only for the growth chart) and whether your baby was born early.
units.12: What you log. Weekly mission sessions and ratings, milestones you tick with their dates and notes, sleep and feeding entries, growth measurements (weight, length and head size), and calendar appointments with reminders.
units.13: Photos. Photos you add to milestones or profiles stay on your phone. They are never sent to us.
units.14: Purchases. We do not collect payment details. Hoppo has no paid features.
units.15: Health data and your explicit consent
units.16: Pregnancy details, growth measurements, and sleep and feeding logs can count as data concerning health. The GDPR gives this data extra protection. We process it only with your explicit consent under Article 9(2)(a) of the GDPR, which you give when you create your account. We use it only to show it back to you in the app, for example in charts, weekly missions and reminders.
units.17: You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting the entries, the profile, or your whole account. Withdrawing consent does not affect what happened before you withdrew it.
units.18: Why we use your data, and on what legal basis
units.19: Running your account and saving your entries: performance of our contract with you (Article 6(1)(b)), plus your explicit consent for health data (Article 9(2)(a)).
units.20: Usage statistics: our legitimate interest in knowing which parts of the app work (Article 6(1)(f)). See below.
units.21: Personalised advertising: your consent (Article 6(1)(a)), given in the app. See below.
units.22: Answering your emails: our legitimate interest in helping you.
units.24: We do not sell your personal data. We do not share your email address, your children's profiles, your logs or your calendar with advertisers or shops. We do not use your children's data for advertising.
units.26: The app shows a small banner advert through Google AdMob. This keeps Hoppo free.
units.27: Pregnancy and health screens. Adverts on pregnancy screens and health screens, such as the guides and the sleep, feeding and growth logs, are always non-personalised. They are not chosen based on you.
units.28: Other screens. When you first open the app, you are asked whether Hoppo may use your data for personalised advertising. On iPhone you also see Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. Adverts are only personalised if you agree. If you consent, your device advertising identifier is shared with Google and its advertising partners, with approximate location and information about how you use the app.
units.29: If you decline, you see the same number of adverts, chosen without using your data. No feature is held back.
units.30: Changing your mind. In the app, open More, then Privacy and data, then Ad privacy options. On iPhone you can also go to Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Tracking. On Android, go to Settings, then Google, then Ads.
units.31: Google acts as an independent controller for the advertising data it receives, under Google's own privacy policy. The website shows no adverts.
units.33: The Shop in the app lists offers from partner shops. Some links are affiliate links, managed through the Awin network. If you tap one, the shop and Awin may set a cookie in your browser to record a later purchase. We do not receive your name, address or payment details from these shops, only reports of how many sales were made. Their own privacy policies apply once you leave Hoppo.
units.35: If you buy a Hoppo family product on hoppoapp.com, we collect your name, delivery address, email address, an optional phone number and what you ordered. We use them to take payment, deliver your order, send receipts, handle returns and keep the accounting records the law requires. The legal basis is the contract with you and our legal obligations (GDPR Article 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(c)).
units.36: Payment is handled by Stripe. Your card details go to Stripe and never reach Hoppo. Stripe has its own privacy policy. Delivery companies receive your name, address and phone number so they can deliver.
units.37: You buy without a Hoppo account. We do not link your order to your account or to your children's profiles, and we do not use your order details for advertising. We keep order records for as long as tax and accounting law requires and delete them afterwards.
units.39: We collect usage statistics through PostHog, hosted in the European Union. For example, we count which screens are opened and how many missions are saved. These events are linked to a random account number, never to your name or email address. They can include which skill or milestone an event is about, and whether a profile is a pregnancy or a child. They do not include your logs, measurements, notes or photos. The app does not use cookies for this.
units.40: The website does not use cookies and does not store anything on your device.
units.42: Reminders for appointments and weekly missions are scheduled on your phone. You can turn them off in the app or in your phone settings.
units.44: Your account and entries are stored with Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany, in the European Union. Usage statistics are stored with PostHog in the European Union. Where a provider may access data from outside the European Union, they use the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
units.45: The website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub receives your IP address when you visit, to deliver the page and keep the service secure. Fonts are served from hoppoapp.com itself.
units.47: We keep your data while your account exists. When you delete your account, it is removed straight away, and from backups within 30 days. Usage statistics are kept for up to 12 months. Emails to us are kept for as long as needed to answer them, and no longer than 2 years.
units.49: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict and move your data, and to object to how we use it. You can also withdraw any consent at any time.
units.50: Correct your data: edit profiles and entries directly in the app.
units.51: Delete everything: open More, then Privacy and data, then Delete account. This permanently deletes your account, your children's profiles, logs and calendar.
units.52: Get a copy of your data: email us and we will send it within 30 days.
units.53: You also have the right to complain to the Slovenian Information Commissioner (Informacijski pooblaščenec), or to the data protection authority in your own country.
units.55: Hoppo is for parents and carers aged 18 and over. Children do not use the app themselves. The data about a child is entered by their parent or carer, who decides what to add and can delete it at any time.
units.57: We will update this page when the policy changes and show the new effective date at the top. If a change affects how we use health data, we will ask for your consent again in the app.

terms.html.title: Terms and Conditions | Hoppo
terms.html.description: Terms and Conditions for the Hoppo parenting app, including the medical disclaimer and affiliate link policy.

units.2: These terms cover your use of the Hoppo app for iPhone and Android and the website hoppoapp.com. By creating an account you accept them.
units.4: Hoppo is operated by Matej Mesko, Slovenia. Contact: info@hoppoapp.com.
units.6: Hoppo is an app for parents and carers, from pregnancy to age 10. It offers weekly practice skills, milestones and keepsake cards, pregnancy information week by week, "Is this normal?" guides, a calendar, and sleep, feeding and growth logs. It is free and is paid for by advertising and affiliate commissions.
units.8: You must be 18 or older to create an account.
units.10: Keep your login details safe. You are responsible for what happens on your account. If you share a login with a partner or carer, you are both responsible for what you add.
units.11: You can delete your account at any time in the app under More, then Privacy and data. Deletion is permanent.
units.13: Hoppo gives general information and practice ideas. It is not medical advice, and it does not replace your doctor, midwife, health visitor or other health professional. It cannot diagnose anything or tell you whether your child is developing normally.
units.14: Every child develops at their own pace. If you are worried about your child or your pregnancy, contact a health professional. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.
units.15: Always stay with your child during the activities in Hoppo, and adapt them to your child and your home. You are responsible for your child's safety while you practise. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for injury, damage or loss that comes from following content in Hoppo.
units.17: You may only add data about a child you are the parent or legal carer of, or have that person's permission to add. How we handle this data is explained in the Privacy Policy.
units.19: Do not misuse Hoppo. For example, do not try to access other people's accounts, interfere with the service, copy the app or its content in bulk, or use it for anything unlawful. We may suspend an account that breaks these rules.
units.21: The skills, guides, texts, images, the Hoppo character and the design belong to us. You may use them for your own family. You may not copy, republish or sell them. You may share your own keepsake cards with family and friends.
units.23: The app shows a small banner advert through Google AdMob. Adverts on pregnancy and health screens are never personalised. The full detail is in the Privacy Policy. The website shows no adverts.
units.24: The Shop lists offers from partner shops and products from the Hoppo family. Some links are affiliate links. If you buy through one, Hoppo may earn a commission. This costs you nothing extra.
units.25: A purchase from a shop is a contract between you and that shop, under its terms. We do not control its prices, stock, delivery or returns. Questions about an order go to the shop.
units.27: We aim to keep Hoppo available, but we cannot promise it will always work without interruption. Features may change. If we stop offering Hoppo, we will give reasonable notice in the app where possible, so you can save what you need.
units.29: Hoppo is provided as it is. As far as Slovenian and European Union law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including your rights as a consumer.
units.31: We may update these terms. We will show important changes in the app before they take effect. The effective date at the top shows the current version.
units.33: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Slovenia. This does not remove the protection of the consumer law of the country where you live.

shop-terms.html.title: Terms of sale | Hoppo
shop-terms.html.description: Terms of sale for Hoppo family products: prices, delivery in the EU, the 14 day right to withdraw, faulty goods and promo codes.

units.3: Products marked "From the Hoppo family" are sold by {{seller_name}}, {{seller_address}}, {{seller_country}}. {{seller_vat_line}}Email: {{seller_email}}.
units.5: These terms cover orders for Hoppo family products on hoppoapp.com. Partner shops listed in Shop sell under their own terms. A purchase from a partner shop is a contract between you and that shop.
units.7: Prices are in euros and include VAT where it applies. Delivery costs and any discount are shown in your cart before you pay.
units.9: Add products to your cart, choose your country, enter a promo code if you have one, and pay on the secure Stripe page. You enter your name and delivery address there. Your order is confirmed when your payment succeeds and Stripe sends your receipt by email. We may cancel and refund an order if a product is unavailable or a price was shown by mistake.
units.11: Payment is handled by Stripe. Your card details go to Stripe and never reach Hoppo.
units.13: We deliver within the European Union. The delivery cost for your country and the expected delivery time are shown in your cart. The goods become your risk when you receive them.
units.15: You may withdraw from your order within 14 days after you receive the goods, without giving a reason. Tell us clearly by email, for example "I withdraw from my order number 1001". Send the goods back within 14 days after you tell us. We refund the price and the standard delivery cost within 14 days after we receive the goods, or after you show that you sent them. You pay the cost of returning the goods unless we agree otherwise.
units.16: The right does not apply to goods made to your specification, or to sealed goods that cannot be returned for hygiene reasons once you have opened them.
units.18: EU law gives you a legal guarantee of at least 2 years from delivery. If a product is faulty or not as described, contact us. You are entitled to a repair, a replacement, a price reduction or a refund, under the rules of your country.
units.20: A promo code has no cash value and applies to products, not to goods already ordered. You can use 1 code per order. A code may have an end date, a minimum order or a limited number of uses. We may withdraw a code at any time. A code already applied to a confirmed order stays valid for that order.
units.22: Read the age and care information that comes with each product. Always supervise babies and children with toys, textiles and small parts.
units.24: How we use your order details is explained in our Privacy Policy.
units.26: Slovenian law applies, without taking away the consumer protection of the country where you live. If you have a complaint, write to us first. We will answer within 14 days.

partners.html.title: Partner with Hoppo | Hoppo
partners.html.description: Reach parents from pregnancy to age 10 through the Hoppo Shop. Affiliate links via Awin or promo codes, shown in the app and on this website.

units.1: Hoppo reaches parents while they plan, prepare and settle in: from pregnancy to age 10. Our Shop puts your offer in front of them, inside the app and on this website.
units.3: Expecting parents and parents of babies and toddlers in the European Union, using the app in 11 languages. They open it weekly for a skill, a guide or a milestone.
units.5: A partner card in the Shop: your name, logo, offer, promo code and link. It shows natively, never as an interruption, and only to parents in countries you serve.
units.7: Affiliate links through Awin, or a unique promo code per partner. Every sale is measurable on both sides.
units.9: We work with merchants on the Awin network, so tracking and payment follow your existing programme. Direct deals are possible too: a fixed fee per new customer, or a flat monthly placement. Rates are agreed per partner.
units.11: A percentage off the first order, free delivery, a free sample with a purchase, and a first month free for subscriptions. Useful categories are baby equipment and clothing, toys and books, food, services and insurance.
units.13: A tap on a partner card opens the phone browser, not a window inside Hoppo. The browser keeps your tracking cookie, so the sale is credited correctly. Offers and promo codes are served from our own database, so a change goes live the same day without an app release. Every affiliate link is disclosed to the parent next to the link.
units.15: We never list infant formula, because EU rules restrict its marketing. We also do not list products that make medical claims.
units.17: Our own home made products will join the Shop when they are ready. They are sold on this website, never inside the app.
units.19: Write to info@hoppoapp.com with your brand, the countries you serve and your Awin programme if you have one. See the current Shop.
